Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them have positive reviews and a reputation for fresh, flavorful food. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamthaisushi.com](https://www.siamthaisushi.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad Thai** (no egg, tofu or shrimp)
• **Vegetarian Green Curry** (tofu, mixed veggies, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup** (vegetable broth, mushrooms, lemongrass) | | **Baan Thai** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑5678 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | • **Vegetarian Massaman Curry** (potatoes, carrots, peanuts, tofu)
• **Vegetarian Pad Krapow** (tofu, basil, chili)
• **Vegetarian Spring Rolls** (fresh veggies, rice paper) | | **Thai Orchid** | 400 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60654 | (312) 555‑9876 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | • **Vegetarian Red Curry** (tofu, bell peppers, bamboo shoots)
• **Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Bok Choy** (garlic, soy sauce)
• **Vegetarian Mango Sticky Rice** (dessert) | | **Lanna Thai Kitchen** | 1500 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (773) 555‑4321 | [lannathai.com](https://www.lannathai.com) | • **Vegetarian Panang Curry** (tofu, sweet potatoes, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Pad See Ew** (tofu, broccoli, soy sauce)
• **Vegetarian Coconut Soup** (mushrooms, lemongrass) | | **Thai Garden** | 3000 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 555‑2468 | [thaigarden.com](https://www.thaigarden.com) | • **Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup** (coconut milk, mushrooms, galangal)
• **Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao** (tofu, basil, chili)
• **Vegetarian Fried Rice** (tofu, peas, carrots) | ### How to Order * **Online Delivery** – Most of these restaurants partner with UberEats, DoorDash, or Grubhub. Check their website or the delivery app for vegetarian menus. * **Take‑out** – Call ahead to confirm vegetarian options are available and to place an order. * **Dine‑in** – If you’re visiting, let the server know you’re vegetarian; many Thai chefs can customize dishes on the spot. ### Tips for Vegetarian Thai Food 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** – Thai cuisine often uses fish sauce or shrimp paste; request a vegetarian version or ask for it omitted. 2. **Look for tofu, tempeh, or seitan** – These proteins are common in vegetarian Thai dishes. 3. **Check for hidden animal products** – Some sauces contain fish sauce or oyster sauce; ask for alternatives. 4. **Enjoy the desserts** – Many Thai desserts are naturally vegetarian (e.g., mango sticky rice, coconut ice cream). Enjoy your meal! If you’d like more detailed menu items or want to explore other neighborhoods, just let me know.
